title: Endless Fall
description: Continuous terminal-speed free fall between aligned floor and high wall/ceiling portals.

title: High Fling
description: Dropping into a floor portal launches a ball high out of a raised, angled exit.

title: Perpetual Ball Loop
description: An emitter continuously feeds balls down a ramp into a floor portal looping back.

title: Portal Straddle
description: A tall stack of boxes resting half-way through an upright wall portal.

title: Recursive Corridor
description: Two portals facing each other on opposite walls creating an infinite recursive mirror.

title: Portal Staircase
description: A tiered series of stepped platforms connected through portal links.

title: Domino Run
description: A chain of domino planks that topple into a portal and emerge continuing on the other side.

title: Sandbox Starter
description: An open room with platforms, a ramp, and one linked portal pair ready for sandbox building.
